name: Lisa Brooks
title: Nurse Practitioner
bio: Lisa is a Colorado native who earned her bachelor's degree from Metropolitan State University of Denver and her master's degree from the University of Colorado Anschutz. Prior to joining CCPSA, she worked as a nurse for seven years in both inpatient critical care and the outpatient setting at National Jewish Health. Outside of work, Lisa enjoys skiing, hiking, scuba diving, and travel. She loves exploring new places, experiencing different cultures, and spending as much time outdoors as possible.
